evidence_status: Requires source-supported review, not regex citation credit
qualifications: The $34,800 insurance figure is a plan-asserted renewal allowance (Property-and-Plan.pdf p.2). No insurer certificate, binder or quote document is in the packet, so verified_renewal_insurance is reported as unknown/null; underwriting still uses $34,800 as instructed, making UW NOI, value and all sizing outputs conditional on that allowance.

The underwriting scenario is the supplied plan, not a lender-approved forecast. Scenario gross potential rent ($780,000) exceeds both T12 actual ($759,600) and annualized in-place contractual rent ($720,000); the source of the increment, including any lease-up of vacant suite 110, is not documented.
Only premises 101 has executed lease evidence. The other eight occupied suites rest on the rent roll alone; no leases, amendments or estoppels were supplied, so their terms are unverified.
The 101 renewal option has no exercise notice, acknowledgment or amendment in the packet, so the option is treated as unexercised and the 2029-08-31 expiry is not extended.

Prepayment: no bank penalty, but a separately documented interest-rate swap may carry a termination payment or receipt. The swap notional, fixed rate, maturity and mark were not supplied, so exit cost/benefit is unquantifiable from this packet.

T12 capital improvements of $74,000 far exceed the $4,320 underwritten reserve; no property condition report was supplied to test reserve adequacy. Capex, existing debt service and depreciation are excluded from operating expense per the plan.

No appraisal, environmental report, market comparables, sponsor track record, tenant financials or credit approval was supplied; indicative value is a direct capitalization of scenario NOI at a supplied cap rate and is not an appraisal. Lender terms are nonbinding discussion terms dated 2026-09-01. This is internal-review analysis, not a credit commitment or legal opinion.
Displayed dollars are rounded; all sizing uses unrounded intermediates per Lender-Terms.pdf p.1.

No leasing costs (TI/LC), downtime, escrows, interest reserve, holdback or fee capitalization are funded or assumed; rollover of ~44% of occupied area occurs 2027-2029 within the 60-month term, and market rents equal in-place rents in the supplied data.
blocked: verified_renewal_insurance cannot be established: no insurer certificate, binder, quote or endorsement document is in the packet, only the plan's assertion of a $34,800 renewal allowance.
Swap termination payment/receipt cannot be quantified: no swap confirmation, notional, fixed rate, maturity or mark-to-market was supplied.
Leases/estoppels for the eight occupied suites other than premises 101 were not supplied, so their rents and expiries rest on the rent roll alone.
No appraisal, market comparables, property condition report, tax assessment, tenant financials or sponsor track record was supplied; no external research was performed.
